title: Adjoining independent variables to a fixed local power-series map
statement: Let c,n,e be natural numbers. Let Lambda_A and Lambda_B be commutative rings, with R=Lambda_A[[X_1,...,X_n]] and S_0=Lambda_B[[Z_1,...,Z_e]] regular local, and S_0 complete. If c=0, suppose Lambda_A is a characteristic-zero field and Lambda_B a field; if c≠0, suppose both are Cohen rings for c [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring]. Let phi:R→S_0 be local. Let t be the canonical list of the X variables if c=0, and c followed by these variables otherwise. Then S=Lambda_B[[Y_1,...,Y_n,Z_1,...,Z_e]] is complete regular local, and there are a surjective local map pi:S→S_0 and a local map h:R→S with pi h=phi, and a list z in S such that t.map h ++ z is a regular system of parameters [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters].

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: For coefficient fields take S = Lambda_B[[Y_1,...,Y_n,Z_1,...,Z_e]], of dimension n+e. For Cohen coefficients of residue characteristic c take the same ring of dimension n+e+1, with c as the first parameter. The power-series regular-completeness theorem supplies regularity and completeness. This includes n=0 or e=0.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: Delete the Y variables and identify the remaining variables with Fin e. The quotient-variables theorem gives a surjection pi:S→S_0 with section iota:S_0→S. The section is local because renaming preserves constant coefficients and a series is a unit exactly when its constant coefficient is a unit. The surjection is local.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: Evaluate the source power series in S with coefficient map iota phi C and variable images iota(phi(X_i))+Y_i. Locality of phi and iota puts these images in the maximal ideal. The adic-evaluation theorem constructs h. The standard source maximal-ideal generators (variables and possibly c) map into the target maximal ideal, so h is local. Both pi h and phi are continuous for the variable-ideal to maximal-ideal topology, agree on constants and variables, and the evaluation uniqueness theorem in complete S_0 gives pi h=phi.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

proof.text: Let z be the ordered Z variables. The ideal generated by h(t) and z contains all Z_j and, in the Cohen case, c. Since phi(X_i) lies in the maximal ideal of S_0, its image under iota belongs to this ideal. Subtract iota(phi(X_i)) from h(X_i) to obtain Y_i. Thus the list generates the full maximal ideal of S. Its length is n+e (field case) or n+e+1 (Cohen case), exactly dim S. This is a regular system of parameters by definition.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NN, proof; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NN

lean.statement:
theorem exists_power_series_parameter_perturbation
    {ΛA : Type u} {ΛB : Type v} [CommRing ΛA] [CommRing ΛB] (n e c : ℕ)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB)]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB))
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB)]
    (hzeroA : c = 0 → IsField ΛA ∧ CharZero ΛA)
    (hposA : c ≠ 0 → IsCohenRing c ΛA)
    (hzeroB : c = 0 → IsField ΛB) (hposB : c ≠ 0 → IsCohenRing c ΛB)
    (φ : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB) [IsLocalHom φ]
    (t : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA))
    (ht : t = if c = 0 then List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n ↦ (X i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA))
      else (c : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA) :: List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n ↦ X i)) :
    ∃ (_ : IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB)),
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB))
        (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB) ∧
      ∃ (π : MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin e) ΛB)
        (h : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛA →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB),
        Function.Surjective π ∧ IsLocalHom π ∧ IsLocalHom h ∧ π.comp h = φ ∧
        ∃ z : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin (n + e)) ΛB),
          IsLocalRing.IsRegularSystemOfParameters (t.map h ++ z)
